claims: Sean Penn won the 2026 Oscar for Best Supporting Actor for his role as Colonel Steven J. Lockjaw in One Battle After Another.

Sean Penn was nominated for the 2026 Best Supporting Actor Oscar alongside Benicio Del Toro (One Battle After Another), Jacob Elordi (Frankenstein), Delroy Lindo (Sinners), and Stellan Skarsgård (Sentimental Value).

The 2026 Best Supporting Actor Oscar nominees were Sean Penn (One Battle After Another), Benicio Del Toro (One Battle After Another), Jacob Elordi (Frankenstein), Delroy Lindo (Sinners), and Stellan Skarsgård (Sentimental Value).
Sean Penn secured his third Oscar win for his performance in One Battle After Another.
One Battle After Another is a Paul Thomas Anderson film.
Stellan Skarsgård was a Golden Globe winner.
Jacob Elordi was a Critics Choice winner.
Stellan Skarsgård and Jacob Elordi were top competitors.
Variety listed Skarsgård as a strong contender early on.
The 2026 Best Supporting Actor Oscar award was presented at the 98th Academy Awards on March 15, 2026.
